en: If the nearest jeepney is over 600 m of walking from you, an extra option “Tricycle, then Jeep R6” (or the route that serves the area) takes a tricycle to the jeepney’s loading point first. Its fare reads “From”: the jeepney estimate plus the ₱15 tricycle minimum. Tricycle time is not estimated.

en: Naga licenses tricycles by colour zone, and no city list of TODAs exists. Zone tricycles shuttle between their centro and a junction. TODA terminals at Ateneo or at jeepney terminals are owner reports we could not confirm.

Ulat ng may-ari ng proyekto ang mga terminal ng TODA sa Ateneo o sa mga terminal ng jeep, at hindi pa namin ito makumpirma.
